name: toy-120
cmd: nproc; GDP_ENUM_LOG=1 GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 360 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 120000 --only toy_consensus_forall --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E '^\[enum\]|join (enumerated|end)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-300 | tail -c 40000; times; exit $s
